name: Preview a jersey then continue to the Google Form
description: Verifies a jersey card opens a larger preview first and the order button opens the official Google Form.
steps: Select the V1 Infernal jersey image
Verify the enlarged image and V1 name appear
expected: The V1 preview opens with its large image and title. The order CTA opens the supplied Google Form in a new tab.

name: Open and close a jersey preview on mobile
description: Verifies the preview is usable on mobile and can be dismissed without leaving the page.
steps: Open the landing page at a mobile viewport
Close the preview with the close button
Open it again and tap Order This Jersey
expected: The image fits the mobile screen, close dismisses the preview, and order opens the Google Form.

name: Share the landing page link
description: Verifies the share action works and metadata points to the public Asylum share preview.
steps: Use the native share sheet when available or the copy-link fallback
expected: The share UI or copy fallback works and Open Graph/Twitter metadata reference the share image hosted in the GitHub branch.
